---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability for USK
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? A paragraph or two on the pain point. "I want to do X but Y makes it hard" is the shape we are looking for.

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want USK to do. Concrete is better than abstract.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you consider? Why is the proposed solution better? Mention workarounds, related projects, or competing tools.

## Additional context

- Mockups, examples, links, prior art
- Whether you would be willing to submit a PR for this
- Which part of the workspace it touches (`usk-core`, `usk-cli`, a new adapter crate, etc.)
